B0_surprisal.assignment: After complete B0 local scoring, sort finite B0 raw K1 surprisal ascending, break exact ties by item_id lexical order; zero-based rank r of n valid baselines goes to bin floor(4*r/n)+1. All512 valid gives four128-document bins.
B0_surprisal.definition: Negative B0 raw K1 log likelihood of the true first continuation token; not predictive entropy.
B0_surprisal.missing: Every unavailable/nonfinite/error B0 raw K1 item stays in an explicit unassigned_baseline_failure stratum; do not impute, drop, or resample it.
B0_surprisal.reuse: Freeze one item-to-bin map with source score SHA and empirical ranges before trained local analysis; reuse unchanged for all same-model and crossed-reader DEV512 results. Never recompute bins from C/R outcomes.

comparisons.absolute_arms: All six conditions at each horizon, including statuses and denominator in every stratum.
comparisons.cross_model: Same fixed stratum membership for predeclared C/R/B0 contrasts; seed-specific results remain separate.
comparisons.multiplicity: Strata and K4/K16 are secondary descriptive analyses; they do not select checkpoints or replace the aggregate K1 primary.
comparisons.uncertainty: Paired document bootstrap,5000 replicates,seed17, sampling documents within the fixed stratum with replacement; conditional on checkpoints. No numeric contrast/CI with fewer than2 documents or any required pair missing/nonfinite. Successful-only descriptive likelihoods must be explicitly labeled.

purpose: Secondary description of existing fixed random development audit; primary all-document contrasts and training unchanged

rule_order: punctuation_or_symbol: every character is whitespace or Unicode category P or S
